#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
typedef pair<int,int> pii;

const int MAXN = 25;
const int INFV = 10007;

int distZ[MAXN][MAXN];
string gridS[MAXN], gridT[MAXN];
int N, K;
int dx[4] = {1,0,-1,0};
int dy[4] = {0,1,0,-1};
vector<pii> startCells, endCells;
int memo[65][12][12][12][12];

struct Edge {
    int from, to, cap, flow;
    Edge(int from, int to, int cap, int flow = 0) : from(from), to(to), cap(cap), flow(flow) {}
};

struct PushRelabel {
    int n;
    vector<Edge> edges;
    vector<vector<int>> adj;
    vector<int> height, inQueue, count;
    vector<int> excess;
    queue<int> q;

    PushRelabel(int n) : n(n), count(2*n), adj(n), height(n), inQueue(n), excess(n) {}

    void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
        adj[u].push_back(edges.size());
        edges.emplace_back(u, v, cap);
        adj[v].push_back(edges.size());
        edges.emplace_back(v, u, 0);
    }

    void enqueue(int u) {
        if (!inQueue[u] && excess[u] > 0) {
            q.push(u);
            inQueue[u] = true;
        }
    }

    void push(int idx) {
        Edge &e = edges[idx];
        int pushed = min(e.cap - e.flow, excess[e.from]);
        if (pushed > 0 && height[e.from] > height[e.to]) {
            e.flow += pushed;
            excess[e.to] += pushed;
            excess[e.from] -= pushed;
            edges[idx ^ 1].flow -= pushed;
            enqueue(e.to);
        }
    }

    void relabel(int u) {
        count[height[u]]--;
        height[u] = 2 * n - 2;
        for (int idx : adj[u]) {
            Edge &e = edges[idx];
            if (e.cap > e.flow) height[u] = min(height[u], height[e.to]);
        }
        count[++height[u]]++;
    }

    void gapRelabel(int h) {
        for (int u = 0; u < n; ++u) {
            if (height[u] >= h && height[u] < n) {
                count[height[u]]--;
                count[height[u] = n]++;
                enqueue(u);
            }
        }
    }

    void discharge(int u) {
        for (int i = 0; excess[u] > 0 && i < (int)adj[u].size(); ++i)
            push(adj[u][i]);
        if (excess[u] > 0) {
            if (height[u] < n && count[height[u]] < 2) gapRelabel(height[u]);
            else relabel(u);
        } else if (!q.empty()) {
            q.pop();
            inQueue[u] = false;
        }
    }

    int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
        height[s] = n;
        inQueue[s] = inQueue[t] = true;
        count[0] = n - (count[n] = 1);
        for (int idx : adj[s]) {
            excess[s] += edges[idx].cap;
            push(idx);
        }
        while (!q.empty())
            discharge(q.front());
        return excess[t];
    }
};

void bfs(int sx, int sy) {
    memset(distZ, -1, sizeof distZ);
    queue<pii> q;
    distZ[sx][sy] = 0;
    q.push({sx, sy});
    while (!q.empty()) {
        pii p = q.front(); q.pop();
        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
            int nx = p.first + dx[d], ny = p.second + dy[d];
            if (nx < 0 || nx >= N || ny < 0 || ny >= N) continue;

            distZ[nx][ny] = distZ[p.first][p.second] + 1;
            q.push({nx, ny});
        }
    }
}

    if (sx == tx && sy == ty) return true;

    if (distZ[sx][sy] <= t) return false;

    if (res != -1) return res;
    for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
        int nx = sx + dx[d], ny = sy + dy[d];
        if (nx < 0 || nx >= N || ny < 0 || ny >= N) continue;
        if (gridS[nx][ny] == 'Y' || gridS[nx][ny] == 'Z') continue;
        if (canReach(t + 1, nx, ny, tx, ty)) return res = 1;
    }
    return res = 0;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    memset(memo, -1, sizeof memo);
    cin >> N >> K;
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) cin >> gridS[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) cin >> gridT[i];
    int zx = -1, zy = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j)
            if (gridT[i][j] == 'Z') zx = i, zy = j;
    bfs(zx, zy);
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j)
            if (distZ[i][j] == -1) distZ[i][j] = INFV;

    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
            char c = gridS[i][j];
            if (c != 'Z' && c != 'Y' && c != '0') startCells.push_back({i, j});
        }
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
            char c = gridT[i][j];
            if (c != 'Z' && c != 'Y' && c != '0') endCells.push_back({i, j});
        }

    int srcCount = (int)startCells.size();
    int snkCount = (int)endCells.size();

#include <bits/stdc++.h>

typedef long long ll;
typedef pair<int,int> pii;

const int MAXN = 25;
const int BIG = 10007;

int dx[4] = {1,0,-1,0};
int dy[4] = {0,1,0,-1};
vector<pii> srcList, snkList;
int memo[65][12][12][12][12];

struct EdmondsKarp {
    int n;
    vector<vector<int>> cap;
    vector<vector<int>> adj;
    EdmondsKarp(int n) : n(n), cap(n, vector<int>(n, 0)), adj(n) {}
    void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
        if (c <= 0) return;
        if (cap[u][v] == 0) {
            adj[u].push_back(v);
            adj[v].push_back(u);
        }
        cap[u][v] += c;
    }
    int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
        int flow = 0;
        const int INF = 1e9;
        while (true) {
            vector<int> par(n, -1);
            queue<int> q;
            par[s] = s;
            q.push(s);
            while (!q.empty() && par[t] == -1) {
                int u = q.front(); q.pop();
                for (int v : adj[u]) {
                    if (par[v] == -1 && cap[u][v] > 0) {
                        par[v] = u;
                        q.push(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (par[t] == -1) break;
            int add = INF;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = par[v])
                add = min(add, cap[par[v]][v]);
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = par[v]) {
                cap[par[v]][v] -= add;
                cap[v][par[v]] += add;
            }
            flow += add;
        }
        return flow;
    }
};

void bfsZ(int sx, int sy) {

    queue<pii> q;
    distZ[sx][sy] = 0;

    while (!q.empty()) {
        pii cur = q.front(); q.pop();

            int nx = cur.first + dx[d], ny = cur.second + dy[d];

            distZ[nx][ny] = distZ[cur.first][cur.second] + 1;
            q.push({nx, ny});
        }

}

bool reachable(int tm, int x0, int y0, int x, int y) {
    if (distZ[x0][y0] < tm) return false;

    if (tm >= k) return false;
    if (distZ[x0][y0] <= tm) return false;

        if (reachable(tm + 1, nx, ny, x, y)) return val = 1;
    }

}
